title: Associated quotient sheaf and restricted structure-sheaf pushforward
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], U an affine open, A=\Gamma(Y,U), and I an ideal of A. Let e:i^{-1}(U)\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) be an isomorphism such that i|_U followed by U\to\operatorname{Spec}A equals e followed by the quotient-spectrum morphism. Then the associated sheaf of the A-module A/I [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], restricted along U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A, is isomorphic as an O_U-module to the restriction to U of i_*O_Z [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: Lemma 26.7.3(2), Tag 01I9 (lemma-widetilde-pullback); specialize to the quotient morphism and transport along the affine chart. This supplies the identification implicit in More on Morphisms, Tag 068C.

proof.text: Use the compatibility of the quotient presentation to identify the morphism over the affine chart with Spec(A/I) → Spec A. For each basic open D(g), its inverse image is D(g mod I). The associated structure sheaf on the quotient has sections (A/I)[1/g], with A[1/g] acting by the localized quotient homomorphism. The associated sheaf of the A-module A/I has the same localized sections and action. This is precisely the pushforward comparison for a spectrum map applied to the A/I-module A/I.

These identifications commute with the localization restriction maps. Glue over the basic-open basis and transport along the chart isomorphism. Restricting i_*O_Z to U evaluates on an open V of U as O_Z(i^{-1}V), so it agrees with the pushforward from i^{-1}U. The resulting module-sheaf isomorphism has the claimed source and target.

theorem affine_quotient_restricted_iso {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (I : Ideal (Γ(Y, U)))
    (e : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≅
      Spec (CommRingCat.of ((Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ⧸ I)))
    (he : i ∣_ U ≫ U.toSpecΓ =
      e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) :
    Nonempty (((tilde.functor Γ(Y, U) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.hom).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ((Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ⧸ I))) ≅
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))))
